### US Foods Scholars Program Welcomes 20 New Students to 2026 Class


08/25/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/460693622/files/doc_news/US-Foods-Scholars-Program-Welcomes-20-New-Students-to-2026-Class-2026.pdf)


*Largest Scholar Class to Date Aims to Fuel Culinary Talent Pipeline for Operators*


ROSEMONT, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD), one of America’s leading foodservice distributors, today announced its 2026 class of US Foods Scholars, the largest class in the program’s history. This year’s cohort includes 20 exceptional students from 18 schools nationwide who are pursuing 2- or 4-year post-secondary degrees in culinary arts, hospitality, baking and pastry, or business management programs. Each recipient will receive a **** $20,000 scholarship **** to help advance their post-secondary education, along with access to professional development opportunities through US Foods.


The foodservice industry continues to offer meaningful career pathways for the next generation of talent. According to the National Restaurant Association’s[2026 State of the Restaurant Industry Report](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Frestaurant.org%2Fresearch-and-media%2Fresearch%2Fresearch-reports%2Fstate-of-the-industry%2F&esheet=54594509&newsitemid=20260825844846&lan=en-US&anchor=2026+State+of+the+Restaurant+Industry+Report&index=1&md5=eaab1478169d982bbb2eb6f03a8a3c0d) , restaurant operators expect to add approximately 100,000 jobs in 2026, bringing total industry employment to 15.8 million. The US Foods Scholars program, established in 2017, was designed to help strengthen this talent pipeline by providing financial support and industry exposure to students pursuing careers in foodservice and hospitality. Since its launch, the program has awarded more than $2.8 million in scholarships to more than 140 students, helping recipients continue their education and prepare for careers in the industry.


“It’s an honor to empower the next generation of culinary talent with the resources they need to pursue their career goals,” said Sara Matheu, Vice President of Corporate Communications at US Foods. “Beyond helping these 20 outstanding students reach their full potential, the US Foods Scholars program aims to support the culinary talent pipeline across our growing industry. We look forward to celebrating the scholars’ accomplishments as they move through their education and professional journeys and watching the positive impact they will make.”

The US Foods Scholars program is administered in partnership with Scholarship America. Scholars are selected through a competitive application process that evaluates academic achievement, financial need, and a personal essay highlighting each student’s goals, passion for the industry, and commitment to their future career.


To learn more about the US Foods Scholars program and the newest recipients, visit[www.usfoods.com/scholars](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.usfoods.com%2Fscholars&esheet=54594509&newsitemid=20260825844846&lan=en-US&anchor=www.usfoods.com%2Fscholars&index=2&md5=f2021b4773e8c1bfaebd4fd92afd00b4) .


**About US Foods**


With a promise to help its customers Make It, US Foods is one of America’s great food companies and a leading foodservice distributor, partnering with approximately 250,000 customer locations and foodservice operators to help their businesses succeed. With more than 70 broadline locations and more than 90 cash and carry stores, US Foods and its 30,000 associates provides its customers with a broad and innovative food offering and a comprehensive suite of e-commerce, technology and business solutions. US Foods is headquartered in Rosemont, Ill.
